bear_assumptions: About 0.3x the new USD 3.0 billion revenue-guidance midpoint, net of convertible notes and divided by roughly 184.3 million economic interests, as manufacturing delays persist, gross margin remains near Q3 levels, cash burn and dilution continue, and backlog conversion disappoints.
base_assumptions: About 0.7x the new USD 3.0 billion revenue-guidance midpoint, net of convertible notes and divided by roughly 184.3 million economic interests, as delayed fiscal-2026 projects convert during fiscal 2027 but margins and cash conversion recover only gradually.
bull_assumptions: About 1.3x the new USD 3.0 billion revenue-guidance midpoint, net of convertible notes and divided by roughly 184.3 million economic interests, as manufacturing ramps, data-centre awards convert profitably, gross margin normalises and cash burn ends without material dilution.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if the full review validates share count, cash runway, dilution and profitable backlog conversion and price or fair value restores positive base and confidence-adjusted expected return, favorable bear/base and expected/bear payoff and margin of safety; downgrade further if delivery delays, project costs, cash use, financing or dilution worsen.
